text: Students will take part in a two-week exchange programme during the school holidays.
referenceTranslation: 学生将在学校假期期间参加为期两周的交流项目。

text: 学校将为新生提供学习指导和心理健康支持。
referenceTranslation: The school will provide new students with academic guidance and mental health support.

text: Teachers are encouraged to use technology to create more engaging and inclusive lessons.
referenceTranslation: 学校鼓励教师利用科技设计更具吸引力和包容性的课程。

text: 这项奖学金面向成绩优秀并积极参与社区服务的学生。
referenceTranslation: The scholarship is open to students who achieve excellent academic results and actively participate in community service.

text: The university will work with industry partners to offer more internship opportunities.
referenceTranslation: 大学将与行业伙伴合作，提供更多实习机会。

text: 双语教育有助于学生理解不同文化，并提升他们的沟通能力。
referenceTranslation: Bilingual education helps students understand different cultures and improve their communication skills.

text: The revised curriculum places greater emphasis on critical thinking, collaboration and independent learning.
referenceTranslation: 修订后的课程更加重视批判性思维、协作能力和自主学习。

text: 教育工作者需要在学术要求与学生的整体福祉之间取得平衡。
referenceTranslation: Educators need to strike a balance between academic requirements and students' overall well-being.

text: Lifelong learning has become increasingly important as technological change transforms the skills required at work.
referenceTranslation: 随着技术变革改变职场所需技能，终身学习变得越来越重要。

text: 研究团队将评估线上教学对学生参与度和学习成果的长期影响。
referenceTranslation: The research team will evaluate the long-term impact of online teaching on student engagement and learning outcomes.
